thread:
maria: Quick pulse — shiproom tomorrow. Need final owners for SDK release bits: docs, sampleapps, quickstart CLI, and the changelog slice. Who's taking what?

 tom: I can own docs updates + README sweep. Will open PR today and tag for review.

 alex: Sampleapps: I've got react + node examples mostly done. Need someone to QA the CLI quickstart (auth flow + env vars).

 sasha: I can smoke the CLI tomorrow morning (09:30 PT). If infra hotfix lands before then I'll run full flow.

 maria: Jamal, you were on changelog cutoffs — what's the cutoff time?

 jamal: Cutoff is 2026-03-19T16:00Z per the release calendar. I'll merge release-notes after one last pass.

 alex: Heads-up: CI is flaky for sampleapp telemetry — failing on telemetry v2 API surface.

 tom: Filed https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/789 with repro and log. eng-infra said they'll push a patch today.

 eng-infra-bot: Deploy scheduled: infra/telemetry@v2.1.3 -> staging at 2026-03-18T22:00Z. :rocket:

 sasha: Great — if the patch lands before my slot I'm good. If not, I'll validate fallback path and file a test case.

 maria: Ownership recap: Docs -> @tom; Sampleapps -> @alex (implementation) + @sasha (QA); Changelog -> @jamal; Release notes review -> @maria + @tom. Any missing pieces?

 jamal: I'll also loop Security for a quick config check on the quickstart defaults.

 tom: Small ask — need a 1-2 line blurb for the "breaking changes" section of the changelog (concise). Can someone draft?

 alex: I'll drop a draft blurb in the changelog PR in 15m.

 maria: Thanks. Also attaching the shiproom agenda: https://drive.redwood/shiproom/2026-03-19/agenda.pdf. Please read before the meeting.

 sasha: Quick question — should sampleapps default to hosted API or local dev by default? My vote: hosted for CI, but include a clear env var for local dev.

 maria: Agreed — default to hosted in CI, document the env var and a short local dev section.

 tom: I'll update the quickstart snippets and the README example to reflect that.

 jamal: One last item: add rollback steps for the telemetry change into the runbook. I'll append them now.

 maria: Perfect. If anything else pops up, ping here. I'll close this pulse in 2h if there are no blockers. :thumbsup:
